response.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(ili.product_price / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_item_ratios, AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_items_per_order_item FROM per_item;

assumptions.assumption: Every row in Order_Items is an order item in the average, so an order item with no invoice line items counts as 0 line items (LEFT JOIN). The request does not say whether such items should be excluded.

A ratio is missing when product_price is NULL or derived_total_cost is NULL or 0 (NULLIF turns a zero denominator into NULL). An order item whose line items all have missing ratios contributes no value to the overall average of per-item ratios.

alternatives.interpretation: Only order items that have at least one invoice line item are included, so the line-count average is taken over items with one or more line items (INNER JOIN instead of LEFT JOIN).
